title: A Local-to-Global Propagation Principle for Dirichlet-to-Neumann Maps
summary: We establish four local-to-global propagation results for Dirichlet--to--Neumann maps. Our first two results are proved in the general setting of smooth compact Riemannian manifolds with boundary. The first shows that if two smooth Riemannian metrics coincide in a collar neighborhood of a connected boundary component \(Γ\), then equality of the corresponding local Dirichlet--to--Neumann maps on a nonempty open subset of \(Γ\) propagates to equality of the associated global Dirichlet--to--Neumann maps on all of \(Γ\).
